findings.comment: Signed reporting agreements were not available for staff present. Documents were provided, and employee health policy was discussed. findings.citation_text: 2-103.11 (O) The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under  2-201.11(A). [Pf]

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment: Norovirus disinfection policy provided during pre-opening could not be located. A new copy of disinfection policy was provided. Maintain a copy of the disinfection policy on-site.
findings.citation_text: 2-501.11 A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. [Pf]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
No paper towels are available in the mens restroom. CORRECTED- Paper towels were provided. Ensure paper towels are always available at all handwashing sinks.
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. [Pf]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:

If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. [P]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:

Cease the practice of packaging ice on-site until adequate facilities are available.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-602.11 Ice scoop is unable to be properly cleaned due to lack of adequate facilities (see #48). Based on the available facilities, the ice scoop may only be used for scooping ice into containers that will be used to chill bottled and canned beverages. Any other use is prohibited.

Pink mold accumulation was observed on the lower edge of the metal baffle inside the ice machine. Discoloration (possibly rust) was also observed on the ceiling inside the ice machine. Clean the ice machine as needed, and maintain it clean. 
Equipment such as ice bins and enclosed compartments such as ice makers shall be cleaned at a frequency specified by the manufacturer, or absent manufacturer specifications, at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.citation_text:
750.120 - Bagged ice and Styrofoam cups with ice were observed in a small freezer by the front counter available for purchase. Proper facilities are not currently present to allow for retail sale of ice for consumption. The conditions inside the ice machine, as well as the current storage practice of the scoop, were a cause of concern for potential cross contamination (See #7b; parts A & B). All ice in question was discarded via the mopsink at the request of inspector. Ice will only be used for chilling bottled/canned beverages at this time (See general comments for additional information).

Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
750.120 - A) Ice scoop was observed on top of the ice machine on damp ice bags. Proper use and storage of ice scoop were discussed. Ice scoop was placed in the ice with the handled extended out of the ice.
**However, at this time the ice scoop can only be used for scooping ice that will be used to chill bottled/canned beverages. Ice scoop cannot be used for scooping ice for consumption (See #16, #20a, #31, and general comments for details). 

B) Inside ice machine was observed with mold on the metal baffle and rust accumulation on the ceiling behind the baffle. The ice in the machine cannot be used for consumption at this time. If/when the owner gets proper facilities, inside the ice machine will require proper wash, rinse, and sanitize on a routine basis to minimize buildup of mold and rust.  

Food and equipment shall be protected from potential cross contamination at all times.
findings.citation_text:
750.130 - Raw shell eggs were stored on a shelf above bottled beverages. Cartons of shell eggs were moved to the bottom shelf in the retail cooler.

All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or away from raw foods.

findings.comment:
750.1350c - Facility has a lot of clutter and unused items. These items include, but are not necessarily limited to, three coolers, empty plastic coffee containers, boxes, an unused Patron display, a table saw, and flats of beverages. Two of the coolers don't work, and one is for sure supposed to be removed. The other non-functioning cooler may be kept for use if it can be repaired. The third cooler works but is not currently being used but will be relocated for use once the broken coolers are addressed. All clutter and unused items need to be removed from the facility. 

Also, ice bags and Styrofoam cups used to package ice for sale and consumption must be removed and no longer used until the owner has proper facilities installed to allow for handling/serving ice to customers. 
Ice bags were taken by employee for personal use, and Styrofoam cups will be kept for personal use by staff when coffee is made (coffee for staff only). 

Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment: 750-100 See violation 4 and 3A as well. A number of the foods in the three door freezer are observed soft, bloated, and in obviously water-damaged condition. A number of containers of foods were discarded due to water appears to be repeated freezing and thawing. Packages are bloated and white where water has left soft packaging to be scraped clear of color. Stoufferr's Lasagna with Meat Sauce (10.5oz) were discarded (eleven units). Stouffer's Macaroni and Cheese Meals(12oz) were discarded (eleven units). And, Stouffer's French Bread Pizza Pepperoni (11 1/4 oz) was discarded (three units). Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750-250  Observed the freezer to be holding foods at 34-36F. The unit is observed in defrost, however, the cycle is too long or some other complicating factor is allowing foods to thaw and reach temperatures beyond freezing. Ice creams and frozen meals are observed soft. During the inspection, defrost cycle completed and freezer was observed returning to temperatures of 17F. See violation #4.  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.comment: 750-260 There is only one display freezer in this facility. See violation #3a. Owner was able to call for maintenance service during the inspection. The freezer should not be defrosting so long to allow foods to melt. There will be spot checks conducted to insure freezer is holding proper temperature.  Enough hot or cold storage units used for displaying potentially hazardous foods shall be provided to maintain proper product temperature requirements.

findings.title: Cross-contamination, equipment, personnel, storage
findings.comment: 750-160  Metal ice scoop is observed being stored on a soiled ice machine surface. Discussed cleaning of machinery and the cleaning of the ice scoop. See violation 20a - facility does not have a three compartment sink. Cease using the ice scoop to scoop ice. Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750-120(a) Stouffer's meals are observed in boxes that have been regularly thawed and re-frozen due to long defrost cycle. Ice accumulates on the top of the three door freezer, defrost causes thaw and melting. Store food protected from overhead ice until the defrost cycle at this cooler is corrected. Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-690 Observed the handsink in the mens room to not be properly caulked to the wall. Seal the sink to the wall. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Dishwashing facilities designed, constructed, operated (1. wash 2. rinse 3. sanitize)
findings.comment: 750-820a There is no three compartment sink present in the facility.  Cease using food service equipment or provide a three compartment sink.  For manual washing, rinsing and sanitizing of utensils and equipment, a sink with no fewer then three compartments shall be provided and used..

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment: 750-800b  There is no three compartment sink in the facility. Cease using ice scoops and other food service equipment until there is a three compartment sink installed. Use single-service scoops with handle to scoop ice into rolling display carts. Ice is not for consumption.  To prevent cross-contamination, kitchenware and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed and sanitized after each use and following any interruption of operations during which time contamination may have occurred.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Observed the following non-food contact surfaces to be soiled: 1) inside of the three door freezer (molds and food crumbs); 2) plastic sliders within the three door cooler (mold and splash); 3) doors of the glass coolers (smears and splash); 4) fans of the glass door coolers (dust); and 5) shelves of the single door Pepsi cooler (mold and splash).  Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment: 750-1120 The handsink in the mens toilet room does not have hot water. Provide hot water for this handsink.  Each lavatory shall be provided with hot and cold water tempered by means of a mixing valve or combination faucet.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
750-1120e The facility does not have paper towels in the mens toilet room. Provide paper towels. A supply of soap and and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.
750-1110d The mens toilet room does not have a covered garbage can. Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: 750-1160 Observed mouse droppings in the vents of all of the display coolers. Facility has Resilient Pest Control. Remove pest droppings and bleach surfaces.  Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment: 750-1170 Observed significant gaps around the base and left side of the front door. Also, the side door does not have a self-closer. Provide a self-closer for the side door. Repair the front door so daylight is not visible.  Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1220 Areas of flooring are observed thickly coated with dust and facility garbage. The corners and areas under shelving appear to have not been mopped or swept in several months. Dust accumulation in corners is thick. Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
750-1200 See notes in General Comments. The facility has multiple areas where flooring is soft and in immediate need of repair. The floor behind the display counters is covered with white pegboard, the floor infront of the display coolers is simply damaged and void of tile and the floor underneath the Budweiser decal is soft and bubbling. Finally, the floor going into the bathroom, storage room, side door, and front door is damaged and broken. Repair the floor.  All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
750-1200 The coving in the toilet room has been repaired with foam caulking. The caulking is observed soiled and water damaged. The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1210 The ceiling is missing in the toilet room. The ceiling is also acoustic tiling. Provide a ceiling that is smooth and easily cleanable. All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: 750-1310 Observed a spray bottle of cleaner to be stored on the counter adjacent to the microwave. Cease storing chemicals by food service equipment. All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: 750-1350c The facility seems overly cluttered with old equipment, boxes and alcohol. There is an unused ice machine and oven stored by the back door. This seems to obstruct the exit and also present a possible fire hazard. Also, the back storage room has stacks and stacks of paperwork, boxes, and rolling cart coolers in the far end. Organize and clean the facility so surfaces do not present a potential harborage for pests or a fire hazard. Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment: 750-100 In the far back of the cooler there was a packaged of Farmland Deli Style Franks Jumbo in a brown paper bag. The franks were grey. Discarded during the inspection. ALSO, observed a container of individually wrapped string cheese (also in the far back of the cooler) to be expired  on January 27, 2015. Discarded during the inspection. Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750-250 The long glass display cooler is holding temperature over 49F. Foods from the front to the back were probed and found to be between 49 and 54F. All potentially hazardous foods were discarded during the inspection. Owner is calling his refrigeration repair man to get the unit fixed. Thermometer at the top of the cooler reads 60F.   All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Observed the inside of the cooler to be thickly coated with dust and mold. The base of the glass display cooler is littered with dead flies. The air return of the freezer adjacent to the door is observed coated with dust. This freezer is holding temperature at 24-28F. Keep these cold holding units clean and free of dust.  Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment: 750-1170 The front door is observed open upon the start of the inspection. Closed during the inspection. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment: Ice scoop observed with handle in the ice. A second ice scoop is observed to be stored on a paper napkin in a plastic container. 750-290 Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment: The ice scoops in the facility can not be cleaned because there is no 3 part sink. 750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4). They have agreed to stop selling ice until the 3 part sink is operational again or provide single use/disposible scoops until the sink can be replaced.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: The ice scoops have not been properly washed rinsed and sanitized since the three part sink was removed. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use or any time they may have become contaminated. Properly clean utensils or provide single use scoops.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: Floors in the facility are in gross disrepair. The floor in front of the ice machine is in the worst shape. 750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors. A contractor has been contacted to do repairs to the floor in front of the ice machine but the rest of the floors have not been included in the repair process. Repair or replace floors throughout the facility.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: Ceiling tiles over ice machine and 3 part sink area are acoustic. 750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings. Provide smooth washable ceilings.
